titles.romaji: Obake de Ii kara Hayaku Kite
titles.native: おばけでいいからはやくきて

description: A metaphorical expression of a child who got separated from their mother at a department store and is overwhelmed by the anxiety with having to seek a stranger for help (and the experience of being in the security room for lost children).
